title: ArcheType Field Type Contract
summary: Define money, measure, i18n-text, geo and attribute-set field semantics without introducing business-specific models.

criteria: The closed field type set money, measure, i18n-text, geo and attribute-set is human-approved as a type contract before any implementation begins.
money is fixed as value plus currency plus precision plus rounding, and the float money ban is stated as a definition-time rejection rule.
measure is fixed as magnitude plus UCUM unit with canonical unit conversion, and a dimension mismatch is rejected at definition time.
i18n-text is fixed as a locale to value map with a deterministic locale resolution order, and geo stays a type bridge only.
attribute-set/EAV semantics are fixed as value_type, a typed value column per type and a product_attribute_value row bound to one tenant.

risks.desc: A product_attribute_value row without fail-closed tenant scope could leak another tenant's attribute family, option or variant value across the whole catalog surface.
risks.mitigation: Require tenant isolation on every EAV row plus PostgreSQL RLS as a second barrier, with Tenant A/B negative fixtures before human-approved implementation.

risks.desc: Storing money in a generic float or numeric column would silently corrupt precision and rounding and produce legally wrong monetary totals.
risks.mitigation: Fix the float money ban as a definition-time rejection rule and require value plus currency plus precision plus rounding with typed value column storage.

risks.desc: Missing UCUM dimension safety would let an incompatible unit conversion succeed and sum quantities that are not comparable.
risks.mitigation: Reject a dimension mismatch at definition time and require canonical UCUM conversion evidence before any measure implementation.

risks.desc: A field type contract could be misread as authority over the PIM application model, the computation graph or the schema engine.
risks.mitigation: Keep no business-specific model, no computation graph ownership, no schema engine ownership and no PIM application model explicit, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: money is value plus currency plus precision plus rounding; the float money ban makes a generic float or numeric column an invalid storage choice at definition time.
measure is magnitude plus UCUM unit with canonical unit conversion; a dimension mismatch such as kg against lb is rejected when the field is defined, not when it is summed.
i18n-text maps locale to value with a deterministic locale resolution order, and geo is only a typed bridge to scale-gis with no rendering surface of its own.
attribute-set/EAV is defined through value_type, one typed value column per type and product_attribute_value rows, so attribute keys stay data and are never branched on in code.

variant axis definition allows a maximum three axes and resolves values by nearest-wins inheritance from variant to product to family; these five type primitives are the whole scope ve bu tip kümesi insan onayı olmadan genişletilemez.
featureDefs.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/featureDefs: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
featureDefs.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract featureDefs kapsamı. Kapsa: money value/currency/precision/rounding with the float money ban; measure with UCUM unit conversion and dimension mismatch rejection; i18n-text locale resolution; the geo bridge; attribute-set/EAV value_type, typed value column, product_attribute_value, variant axis with maximum three axes and nearest-wins inheritance; append-only type registration and runtime attribute addition without migration. Exclude business-specific models, computation graph ownership, schema engine ownership and the PIM application model. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: tenant isolation is fail-closed: every product_attribute_value row carries a tenant scope and a missing tenant context rejects the operation instead of widening it.
PostgreSQL RLS is a mandatory second barrier on every EAV table so no tenant can read another tenant's attribute family, option or variant value.

mass-assignment prevention uses an explicit typed-field allowlist where value_type selects the typed value column and its validation; human approval is required before any type registration or activation.

Least-privilege separates the definition and value layers, and an immutable audit records every attribute or family definition change with a before/after hash; secret and credential values are never stored in an attribute value.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff uses one discriminated field type union keyed by value_type instead of per-consumer casting, with a short-code bütçe sınırı and katman separation.
unit conversion, locale resolution and nearest-wins inheritance stay deterministic and testable; standard details are referenced through standardRefs instead of copied.
Attribute value reads are planned to avoid N+1 EAV lookups through a single typed value column projection; no runtime implementation is claimed.
codeOptimization.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/codeOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
codeOptimization.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract codeOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: discriminated value_type union, deterministic unit conversion and locale resolution, typed value column projection. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: Boundary validation allowlists value_type, unit, currency and locale before any attribute value is written; unknown type keys are rejected rather than coerced.
Least-privilege holds across the attribute definition and value layers: a value writer cannot register a new field type or relax a rounding rule.
Immutable audit records who changed an attribute or family definition with a before/after hash, while high-volume value changes are audited in batch.
securityOptimization.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: value_type allowlist validation, least-privilege between definition and value layers, immutable definition audit. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: The planned attribute value read targets a p95 of 300 ms or less over a 100k product corpus; no measurement is claimed here.
Typed value column indexing and filtered EAV queries must avoid N+1 lookups; variant axis expansion is bounded by the maximum three axes rule.
Performance evidence must cover locale resolution fan-out and unit conversion cost before any readiness claim.
performance.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: typed value column indexing, filtered EAV query budget, bounded variant axis expansion. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: Mobile, web and service channels consume the same typed field contract and cannot redefine money precision, rounding or a unit locally.
Offline or stale-locale cases fall back through the declared locale resolution order rather than inventing a display value.
No mobile UI surface is introduced; client rendering of money and measure stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: shared typed field contract across channels, locale resolution fallback, no local money or unit redefinition. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future consumer must expose money, measure and locale-resolved text as accessible text with unit and currency stated, not encoded by color or position alone.
Validation rejections such as a dimension mismatch must be announced through an aria live region, stay reachable by keyboard with a visible focus ring and meet the AAA contrast threshold.
This specification creates no UI surface; WCAG evidence remains planned and cannot be marked passed from this governance node.
wcag.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: accessible money/measure/locale text, announced validation rejections, no UI surface here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; any future Docker/Kubernetes deployment of the EAV table, index and UCUM reference data topology remains human-developer work.
A future deployment must preserve append-only type registration and runtime attribute addition without migration under expand-contract.
Rollback must remove only this planning contract and deterministic projections while preserving runtimeDataImpact none and NO-GO.
deployment.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, expand-contract preservation, rollback boundary. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: This contract is type definition, not automation: an attribute definition change may emit a planned event but no ruleset acts on values here.
No webhook, outbox or type activation is created by this node; append-only type registration cannot be bypassed by an automated rule.
Automation may record a planned approval request but cannot register a field type, relax rounding or claim successful runtime execution.
eca.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: definition-change events only, no ruleset value automation, append-only type registration cannot be bypassed. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: AI may read the contract and suggest a changeset, but registering a field type, editing an attribute definition, overriding a rounding rule and bypassing tenant scope are forbidden actions ve yasak kalır.
Human approval and insan onayı are explicit and mandatory before implementation; no automatic apply, admin override or delegated-admin workflow is implied.
Prompt or repository content cannot expand the fixed D01 scope, write platform product code or convert planned-test refs into passed evidence.
aiAgents.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and suggest-changeset only, forbidden type registration and override, mandatory human approval. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases cover each field type: money with currency, precision and rounding; measure with UCUM unit conversion; i18n-text with locale resolution; geo bridging; attribute-set values by value_type.
Planned negatives cover the float money ban, currency mismatch, dimension mismatch, missing locale, a fourth variant axis beyond the maximum three axes and an unknown value_type.
Planned tenant isolation negatives exercise cross-tenant reads and writes on product_attribute_value under PostgreSQL RLS and prove mass-assignment prevention through the typed-field allowlist.
Contract tests must prove nearest-wins inheritance ordering, append-only type registration and runtime attribute addition without migration.
The planned pytest command and kernelIntegration plannedTestRefs are future evidence requirements, not executed platform tests.
testing.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: per-type positive matrices, float money ban and dimension mismatch negatives, variant axis limit, tenant isolation negatives, nearest-wins inheritance and append-only type registration. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A08 software and data integrity risk is modeled through mass-assignment prevention: an explicit typed-field allowlist binds value_type to its typed value column and validation.
OWASP A03 injection risk is modeled by keeping attribute keys as data: values bind as parameters and no attribute code is interpolated into a query or a branch.
OWASP A01 broken access control is modeled through tenant isolation plus PostgreSQL RLS on every EAV table, with cross-tenant attempts rejected without leaking definition internals.
owasp.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A08 mass-assignment prevention, A03 attribute keys as data, A01 tenant isolation with PostgreSQL RLS. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-archetype-fieldtypes with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-archetype-fieldtypes] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
Public boundary flags are all false; consumers receive only the planned public contract and cannot access kernel internals, databases or cross-context writes.
This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor schema-metadata-engine-contract ends 2028-03-15, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.
dependsOn stays exactly schema-metadata-engine-contract and does not inherit the parent-only k-schema, s-pim, scale-gis, k-archetype-computation and product module edges.

Scope stays inside the type layer: no business-specific model, no computation graph ownership, no schema engine ownership and no PIM application model such as product family taxonomy or SKU generation.
integration.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing to k-archetype-fieldtypes, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, planning window marker and the fixed exclusion set. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: App and module consumers use the typed field contract and cannot redefine money precision, a unit dimension or a locale resolution order locally.
A consumer must preserve tenant scope when reading or writing product_attribute_value rows and cannot bypass the typed value column allowlist.
PIM application behaviour, product family taxonomy and SKU generation remain a separate authority for every consumer.
moduleUsage.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: consumer use of the typed field contract, preserved tenant scope, PIM application behaviour excluded. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: Attribute definitions carry metadata rather than raw PII, but attribute values may later carry personal data, so classification, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.
append-only type registration preserves history: a superseded field type stays readable under expand-contract and runtime attribute addition without migration does not rewrite past values.
Value retention and deletion stay purpose-limited and tenant-scoped; no attribute or value store is created by this node.
dataLifecycle.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: value classification and retention, append-only history preservation, tenant-scoped deletion, no store created here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrics include type validation rejection counts by reason, dimension mismatch rate, locale resolution fallback rate and cross-tenant reject counts on tenant-safe labels.
Logs and traces carry value_type, unit, currency and tenant scope with PII redaction; high-cardinality attribute codes and raw values are not metric labels.
Alerts cover any cross-tenant attribute read, a float money storage regression, an append-only type registration violation and a filtered EAV query budget breach; thresholds require human approval.
observability.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: validation rejection SLIs, redacted type labels, cross-tenant and append-only violation alerts. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The primary failure mode is an unknown value_type, a missing UCUM unit definition, an absent locale or an incomplete attribute template; it degrades to rejection and never to a silent default value.
The same input and type version must produce a deterministic typed value; retry and idempotency controls cannot change rounding or unit conversion semantics.
A type version change never mutates stored values in place; append-only type registration and expand-contract preserve read compatibility and rollback safety.
reliability.notes: archetype-field-type-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: ArcheType Field Type Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: fail-closed rejection on unknown type input, deterministic typed value, append-only version evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
